# SLOs and SLIs

## Service Level Indicators (SLIs)

Track at minimum:

- Availability (successful requests / total requests)
- Latency (p50, p95, p99)
- Error rate (5xx and critical 4xx rates)
- Throughput (requests per second)

## Service Level Objectives (SLOs)

Define measurable targets per environment and service.

| SLI          | Example SLO   |
| ------------ | ------------- |
| Availability | 99.9% monthly |
| P95 Latency  | <= 300ms      |
| Error Rate   | < 1%          |

## Error Budget Policy

- Track error budget burn by rolling window.
- Gate risky releases when burn rate exceeds policy thresholds.
- Document temporary exceptions with owner and expiry date.
